slot.brief: Multi-step reaction with given bond enthalpies and/or ΔH of formation; combine via Hess cycles including ΔH = ΔU + Δn_gRT correction to find an enthalpy.

stem: At $300$ K, $\Delta U=-282.8\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ for $\text{CO}(g)+\dfrac{1}{2}\text{O}_2(g)\to\text{CO}_2(g)$. Given $\Delta H_f^\circ[\text{CO}_2(g)]=-394\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ and $R=8.0\ \text{J K}^{-1}\text{mol}^{-1}$, find $\Delta H_f^\circ[\text{CO}(g)]$.

verdicts.working: For the reaction, Δn_g = 1 − 1 − ½ = −½. Thus ΔH = ΔU + Δn_gRT = −282.8 − 1.2 = −284.0 kJ mol⁻¹. Also, ΔH = −394 − ΔH_f°[CO], so ΔH_f°[CO] = −110 kJ mol⁻¹.

working:
$\Delta n_g=1-\left(1+\dfrac{1}{2}\right)=-\dfrac{1}{2}$
$\Delta H_{\text{ox}}=\Delta U+\Delta n_gRT=-282.8-\dfrac{(0.5)(8.0)(300)}{1000}=-284.0\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$
$\Delta H_f^\circ(\text{CO})+\Delta H_{\text{ox}}=\Delta H_f^\circ(\text{CO}_2)$
$\Delta H_f^\circ(\text{CO})=-394-(-284.0)=-110\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$

Independent check: For the reaction, Δn_g = 1 − 1 − ½ = −½. Thus ΔH = ΔU + Δn_gRT = −282.8 − 1.2 = −284.0 kJ mol⁻¹. Also, ΔH = −394 − ΔH_f°[CO], so ΔH_f°[CO] = −110 kJ mol⁻¹.
solution:
For gaseous reactions, $\Delta H=\Delta U+\Delta n_gRT$, where $\Delta n_g=1-(1+\frac12)=-\frac12$.
$$\Delta H=-282.8+\frac{(-\frac12)(8.0)(300)}{1000}=-284.0\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$$
Using $\Delta H=\Delta H_f^\circ(\text{CO}_2)-\Delta H_f^\circ(\text{CO})$, we get $\Delta H_f^\circ(\text{CO})=-394-(-284)=-110\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
